title: Prints, Never Returns
story: doubled() shows the right numbers on screen, but other code that uses its answer gets None.
goal: Diagnose the bug, then fix the code so every check passes.
hints: What does the caller receive from this function?
Replace print(out) with something that gives the list back.
socratic: What did you expect it to do?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
alt:
def doubled(nums):
    return [n * 2 for n in nums]

parrot.says: Squawk! Look, it prints the right numbers! My work here is done.

diagnose.question: Why does other code get None?
options: It prints the list instead of returning it
diagnose.why: print only shows a value. A function hands a value to its caller with return.
